name: DealKeep
description:
DealKeep is the tracker for people who buy lifetime software deals. Connect it to Claude and ask, in plain language, about the stack you already own: "What do I have for email marketing?", "Do I already own something like this before I buy it?", "Which refund windows are about to close?", or "Are any of my tools' founders going quiet?"

Five read-only tools cover it — search your tools, check a purchase for duplicates, pull one license's full detail, list your deals, and surface founder-risk signals. The connector is strictly read-only: it can look across your library but can never buy, redeem, edit, or delete anything, and it only ever sees your own data.

Requires a paid DealKeep plan. Learn more at dealkeep.io.

_published_faq.name: How do I add DealKeep to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add DealKeep to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.dealkeep.io/functions/v1/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the DealKeep MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: DealKeep provides these MCP tools: check_duplicate, founder_risk, get_license, list_deals, ping, and search_my_tools.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to DealKeep?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to DealKeep in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
DealKeep requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
DealKeep is developed by DealKeep. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
